priority: Center placement comes first for container combinations.
rules: Use the intended content area's center, not the complete container canvas center when hardware or furniture changes the usable area.
Try the content center first, then preserve its vertical centerline while adjusting vertical placement for visual balance and clearance.
A sideways clearance-only placement is an explicit visual-review exception, not a visually approved result.

Default to native 32-unit sub-icons with 4-unit strokes and 2-unit ink clearance. When a centered 32-unit combination fails, allow a 24-unit footprint suggestion with the same stroke weight only after vector fit checks; smaller-detail readability still needs visual review.

sub_resize_policy.preview: Keep original native geometry; show optional clearly labeled scaled prototypes for suggested redraws. Prototypes are not final grid-snapped assets.
sub_resize_policy.wide_sub: Suggest a separately authored grid-snapped variant targeting visible height 32, width allowed above 32 if safe interior permits.
sub_resize_policy.tight_sub: Suggest separately authored 24 × 24 variant; verify clearance after redraw.
sub_resize_policy.repair_priority: Preserve meaning and original proportions. Try a modest grid-snapped container expansion first; do not force 32 if that makes the subject look wrong. Use smaller sub-icons where a modest repair is insufficient.
